Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the state's management of the Puget Sound commercial salmon fishery.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state's management of the Puget Soundcommercial salmon fishery; creating a new section; and providing anexpiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of fish and wildlife mustwork with appropriate commercial fishers and commercial fishingassociations to consider ways to facilitate the commercial harvest ofPuget Sound salmon in a manner that conserves the resource, maintainsthe economic wellbeing of the fishing industry, promotes orderlyfisheries, and enhances and improves commercial fishing in the state inaccordance with the intent of RCW 77.04.012. These discussions mustconsider the impacts of economic changes that impact commercialfisheries over time, and keep in mind the wellbeing of all aspects ofthe Puget Sound commercial salmon industry. These discussions aremeant to address current issues within the commercial fishing industry,and will not affect noncommercial fisheries or fishing interests. Thedepartment of fish and wildlife must provide a summary of thesediscussions, recommendations, and outcomes to the appropriatecommittees of the legislature by November 1, 2008. p. 1 SSB 6337 (2) The department of fish and wildlife must carry out therequirements of this section within existing funds. (3) This section expires December 31, 2008.
